ideas.pitch: A desktop tool that visually calculates and simulates optimal instruction sequences for pirate grid-navigation challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Grid Navigation - Teams solve a grid-based logical challenge by determining the correct path or sequence of instructions.
ideas.title: GridVoyager: Automated Grid Pathfinding Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the specific Round 1 format by helping teams pre-calculate and test logic sequences rapidly before committing to final pseudocode submissions.

ideas.pitch: A decision-support dashboard for tracking team coin balances, calculating point multipliers, and optimizing bids during high-stakes technical auctions.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Pirate Bidding Battle - Teams receive 10 coins (50 points each) and bid for technical questions with 2x rewards or penalties.
ideas.title: BiddingStrategy Sim: Pirate Auction Risk Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific round's risk management constraint where bids must be multiples of 50 and cannot be withdrawn, preventing costly strategic errors.

ideas.pitch: A fast offline editor that translates flowchart blocks into structured pseudocode tailored for grid navigation constraints.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Grid Navigation - Solutions must be submitted in pseudocode.
ideas.title: PseudoFlow: Visual Pseudocode Logic Converter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Capitalizes on the strict no-AI rule by providing a structured, syntax-safe way to draft paper-ready pseudocode quickly without violating guidelines.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-fire trivia and technical challenge simulator designed to sharpen response times under a strict 60-second countdown.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Pirate Bidding Battle - The highest bidder gets 60 seconds to answer technical questions.
ideas.title: PirateTrivia Flash: Technical Knowledge Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on speed and accuracy under pressure, directly mimicking the high-stress bidding battle format to build team muscle memory.

ideas.pitch: A live leaderboard and coin calculator tailored for multi-round pirate-themed competitions to track standing and risk exposure.
ideas.problem_statement: Overview: CODE VOYAGE is a pirate-themed technical challenge testing logic, pseudocode, technical knowledge, and strategy across two rounds.
ideas.title: Captain's Log: Tactical Scoreboard Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a polished, thematic interface that enhances the event experience and helps competitors manage points across both rounds.
